nodes.description: Public string state variable storing contract version metadata ('1.0').
Constant bytes32 role identifier MODERATOR_ROLE used for access control of privileged functions.
Address of the new (ERC20) token contract used as source of funds for conversions.
Address of the old token contract authorised to call receiveApproval and to receive downgraded funds.
Boolean flag enabling/disabling convertToOld downgrade conversions.
Boolean flag enabling/disabling receiveApproval upgrade conversions.
Conversion ratio (default 20) between old and new tokens, mutable only by moderators.
TokenConvertor constructor; grants MODERATOR_ROLE to the deployer.
Owner-only function granting MODERATOR_ROLE to a new address.
Owner-only function revoking MODERATOR_ROLE from an address.
Moderator-only function updating oldTokenAddress and newTokenAddress.
Downgrade path converting new tokens to old tokens; only callable by newTokenAddress.
Upgrade path pulling old tokens via transferFrom and sending new tokens; only callable by oldTokenAddress.
Moderator-only function toggling the downgradable flag.
Moderator-only function toggling the upgradable flag.
Moderator-only function updating the conversion ratio.
Access-control modifier requiring the caller to hold MODERATOR_ROLE.
External caller address used for owner/moderator checks and conversion authorisation.
External call oldToken.transfer(_ownerAdd, amount) in convertToOld transferring old tokens to caller-supplied address.
External call newToken.transfer(_ownerAdd, amount) in receiveApproval sending new tokens to caller-supplied address.
External call oldToken.transferFrom(_ownerAdd, address(this), _value) pulling tokens from a user-supplied owner.
Arithmetic in convertToOld: _amount.div(ratio).div(10**newDecimals - oldDecimals) with external decimals values.
Arithmetic in receiveApproval: _value.mul(ratio).mul(10**newDecimals - oldDecimals) with external decimals values.
Address parameter of AddModerator receiving the new moderator role.
Address parameter of RemoveModerator whose role is revoked.
Address parameter of setAddress that becomes oldTokenAddress.
Address parameter of setAddress that becomes newTokenAddress.
Amount parameter of convertToOld, divided by ratio and decimal offset.
Recipient address parameter used in convertToOld and receiveApproval transfers.
Amount parameter of receiveApproval used for transferFrom and new token transfer.
Token address parameter of receiveApproval cast to OldToken for transferFrom.
Unused bytes parameter of receiveApproval.
Boolean parameter of setDowngradable assigned to the downgradable state variable.
Boolean parameter of setUpgradable assigned to the upgradable state variable.
uint256 parameter of updateRatio assigned to the ratio state variable.
Local OldToken instance in convertToOld bound to oldTokenAddress.
Local IERC20 instance in convertToOld bound to newTokenAddress, used for decimals().
Local OldToken instance in receiveApproval bound to _token.
Local IERC20 instance in receiveApproval bound to newTokenAddress, used for decimals() and transfer.

edges.reason: Constructor grants MODERATOR_ROLE during deployment, establishing the initial privileged role.
Constructor uses msg.sender as the initial moderator account.
AddModerator passes the caller-supplied _newModerator into _setupRole.
AddModerator grants MODERATOR_ROLE to the supplied address.
AddModerator restricted by onlyOwner which compares owner() to _msgSender().
RemoveModerator passes the caller-supplied _oldModerator into revokeRole.
RemoveModerator revokes MODERATOR_ROLE from the supplied address.
setAddress writes the caller-supplied _oldTokenAddress into oldTokenAddress.
setAddress writes the caller-supplied _newTokenAddress into newTokenAddress.
setAddress updates the trusted old token address used for call authorisation.
setAddress updates the trusted new token address used for call authorisation.
onlyModerators checks msg.sender against MODERATOR_ROLE membership.
onlyModerators consults the MODERATOR_ROLE role mapping.
setAddress is gated by the onlyModerators modifier.
setDowngradable is gated by the onlyModerators modifier.
setUpgradable is gated by the onlyModerators modifier.
updateRatio is gated by the onlyModerators modifier.
setDowngradable reads the _downgradable parameter.
setDowngradable writes the new value into the downgradable flag.
setUpgradable reads the _upgradable parameter.
setUpgradable writes the new value into the upgradable flag.
updateRatio reads the _ratio parameter.
updateRatio writes the new value into the ratio state variable.
convertToOld checks the downgradable flag via the isDowngradable modifier.
convertToOld consumes the _amount parameter in the conversion arithmetic.
convertToOld forwards _ownerAdd as the transfer recipient.
convertToOld requires msg.sender to equal newTokenAddress, an authorisation check on caller identity.
convertToOld compares msg.sender against the mutable newTokenAddress state variable.
convertToOld instantiates OldToken from oldTokenAddress.
convertToOld creates the local OldToken instance oldToken.
convertToOld creates the local IERC20 instance newToken.
convertToOld executes the div chain computing the payout amount.
The division uses the moderator-mutable ratio state variable as divisor.
The division operates on the _amount parameter.
convertToOld performs the external old token transfer as its final action.
The old token transfer sends funds to the _ownerAdd address.
The computed conversion amount feeds into the old token transfer call.
The transfer is invoked on the local oldToken instance.
receiveApproval consumes the _value parameter for transfer and conversion.
receiveApproval uses _ownerAdd as the source and destination of the token movements.
receiveApproval casts the caller-supplied _token address to OldToken.
receiveApproval accepts the unvalidated _extraData byte blob.
receiveApproval requires msg.sender to equal oldTokenAddress.
receiveApproval compares msg.sender against the mutable oldTokenAddress state variable.
receiveApproval creates the local OldToken instance oldToken.
receiveApproval creates the local IERC20 instance newToken.
receiveApproval makes the external transferFrom call before minting/sending new tokens.
The transferFrom call uses the user-supplied _value amount.
The transferFrom call is invoked on the caller-supplied old token instance.
receiveApproval executes the mul chain computing the new token payout.
The multiplication operates on the user-supplied _value.
The multiplication uses the moderator-mutable ratio state variable.
receiveApproval performs the outbound new token transfer after an external token pull.
The new token transfer sends tokens to the _ownerAdd address.
The computed multiplied amount feeds into the new token transfer call.
receiveApproval checks the upgradable flag via the isUpgradable modifier.
The external old token transfer hands control to an arbitrary token contract that may re-enter convertToOld.
The external transferFrom call invokes attacker-controllable token code that may re-enter receiveApproval.
The outbound new token transfer may invoke a malicious token contract re-entering receiveApproval.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter only flows into AddModerator's _setupRole call and has no independent semantic role.
Parameter is only consumed by RemoveModerator's revokeRole invocation.
Parameter is written directly to oldTokenAddress inside setAddress.
Parameter is written directly to newTokenAddress inside setAddress.
Parameter is used solely in convertToOld's division arithmetic and transfer amount.
Recipient parameter passed into the old token transfer of convertToOld.
Parameter drives both transferFrom and the new token transfer in receiveApproval.
Parameter is cast into the OldToken instance used for transferFrom.
Unused blob parameter belonging to receiveApproval's signature.
Parameter is assigned to the downgradable state variable in setDowngradable.
Parameter is assigned to the upgradable state variable in setUpgradable.
Parameter is assigned to the ratio state variable in updateRatio.
Local OldToken instance exists only to invoke the external transfer call in convertToOld.
Local IERC20 instance exists only to read decimals() for the conversion arithmetic in convertToOld.
Local OldToken instance exists only to invoke the external transferFrom call in receiveApproval.
Local IERC20 instance exists only to read decimals() and perform the new token transfer.
